description:
Return a list of all Punch Items for a specified Project.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Punch Item Status - 'open' or 'closed'.

parameters.name: filters[priority]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Punch Item Priority -  'low', 'medium', 'high'

parameters.name: filters[punch_item_type_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Punch Item Type ID.

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Location ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Location ID or a range of Location IDs.

parameters.name: filters[include_sublocations]
parameters.description: Use together with `filters[location_id]`

parameters.name: filters[approver_login_information_id]
parameters.description: User ID. Returns item(s) where the specified User ID is an approver.

parameters.name: filters[vendor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Vendor ID.

parameters.name: filters[assignee_response]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with the specified assignee response approved status.

parameters.name: filters[trade_id]
parameters.description: Trade ID
